content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A silk-blend blouse with a subtle sheen in color #d1ab86 featuring a relaxed yet tailored fit and elbow-length sleeves, paired with high-waisted wide-leg trousers in deep charcoal made from structured wool crepe that fall to the floor. An oversized blazer in matching charcoal wool crepe with notched lapels and two-button closure worn open over the blouse, finished with pointed-toe pumps in patent black leather at a 7 cm heel. The ensemble works perfectly for an autumn evening dinner date because the tailored silhouette conveys confidence and refinement suitable for a smart dress code without appearing overly rigid or stiff. The dark neutral palette harmonizes beautifully with her warm skin tones (#d9b48f) and rich hair color (#745a3b), creating an elegant look that feels appropriate for artificial restaurant lighting while keeping her comfortable enough to enjoy conversation."}
